mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_session_meta (user_id, session_id, tenant_id, title, channel, status, last_active_at, message_count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{tenantId}, #{title}, #{channel}, 'ACTIVE', #{lastActiveAt}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE channel = VALUES(channel), last_active_at = VALUES(last_active_at), message_count = message_count + 1, title = IF(title IS NULL OR title = '', VALUES(title), title)
mapper.select: SELECT session_id, title, channel, last_active_at FROM agent_session_meta WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY last_active_at DESC LIMIT 50
